mapper.sql: id, original_name, url, file_size, content_type, storage_type, remark, created_by, created_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM sys_file
is_deleted = 0
AND original_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.originalName}, '%')
ORDER BY created_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM sys_file WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_file (original_name, url, file_size, content_type, storage_type, remark, created_by, created_time, update_by, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{originalName}, #{url}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{storageType}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{createdTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, 0)
